result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: overlapping/garbled delivery info text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' the delivery metadata text is overlapped/garbled, appearing as '25-30rdelivery' instead of separate readable values.
issues.suggestion: Fix layout of the metadata row to prevent text overlap, e.g. render as '25-30 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' with proper spacing, no absolute overlap, and correct truncation.
